description: This file defines an interface for building and configuring JsonParseOptions objects, allowing customization such as URL decoding options.

classes.name: JsonParseOptionsBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder interface for creating configured JsonParseOptions instances, not thread-safe and not reusable.

methods.name: withUrlDecoding
methods.description: Configures the builder to perform URL decoding on the JSON string to parse.

methods.name: withoutUrlDecoding
methods.description: Configures the builder to avoid URL decoding on the JSON string to parse.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Creates a new JsonParseOptions instance with the configured options.
